concepts.canonical_he: כשאדם יודע שכל מארעותיו הם לטובתו
concepts.gloss_en: When a person knows that all his experiences are for his good — the awareness that is a foretaste of the World to Come

members.form: כשאדם יודע שכל מארעותיו הם לטובתו

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are from Lesson 4 and express the identical idea — knowing all one's experiences are for the good, called a taste of the World to Come. The two surface forms differ only by the leading clause 'כשאדם' (when a person), which is a truncation, not a distinct word or concept. Same phrase, one concept.
